name: AI CV Screener – PDFs → ranked shortlist → Sheets (Harborline demo)

parameters.content:
## AI CV screener (PDFs → ranked shortlist → Sheets + CSV)
**Live demo:** https://n8n.rixgpt.com/webhook/screening

1. Visitor pastes a job description and uploads up to 5 PDF CVs, or ticks the sample set (6 fictional CVs the workflow writes as PDFs itself).
2. **Gemini** reads the job and extracts must-haves / nice-to-haves (one call), then reads every CV as a PDF (3 at a time) and returns score, verdict, must-have coverage with evidence, strengths, gaps, red flags, summary and 3 interview questions.
3. Ranked shortlist → **Google Sheets** (Screening tab) + CSV + private owner view.

Files are read once and never stored; successful executions are not saved. Daily cap 15 screenings. The ranking is a first pass for a recruiter, not a decision.
Built by Aqib ur Rehman. Harborline and the candidates are fictional.
### 1 · Demo page · job text + CVs → Gemini reads the job → Gemini reads each CV → rank → Google Sheets → shortlist
### 2 · Shortlist page · CSV · sample CV PDFs · owner view
